arm.name: bonsai-2026-10-12
arm.description: The Bonsai worker as it ran on 2026-10-12 (garden/bonsai-agent), except worker memory is off (memory is W3) and the session timeout is 20 minutes, not 45.
arm.worker_description: Bonsai 2 27B (Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B, 2-bit), a local model on this machine's GPU

sources.model: autopilot/README.md 'History': to go back to Bonsai set the worker to garden/bonsai-agent; autopilot.py worker_agent_dir() registers it from agent/models.bonsai-agent.json
sources.thinking: autopilot/README.md 'History': garden/bonsai-agent with thinking low; same as evals/arms/baseline.json
sources.max_output_tokens: agent/models.bonsai-agent.json maxTokens 16384; autopilot.py do_work() cut-off message cites the 16k limit
sources.compaction_reserve_tokens: autopilot.py worker_agent_dir(): settings compaction.reserveTokens 28672 for provider garden
sources.session_timeout_min: Changed on purpose: config.json worker_timeout_min was 45; W1 milestone sets 20
sources.worker_memory: Changed on purpose: config.json worker_memory was mem0; W1 milestone sets it off
sources.extensions: autopilot.py worker_agent_dir() copies extensions/submit_request.ts into the agent dir

llama_swap_entry:
env:
      - "LLAMA_ATTN_ROT_DISABLE=1"
    cmd: |
      /home/josiah/Projects/llama.cpp-bonsai2/build/bin/llama-server
      --model /home/josiah/models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PQ2_0.gguf
      --mmproj /home/josiah/models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-mmproj-Q8_0.gguf
      --no-mmproj-offload
      --port ${PORT}
      --n-gpu-layers 99
      --ctx-size 98304
      --parallel 2
      --kv-unified
      --threads 8
      --flash-attn on
      --cache-type-k q4_0
      --cache-type-v q4_0
      --kv-mean-center /home/josiah/models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PQ2_0-kv-bias.gguf
      --temp 1.0
      --top-p 0.95
      --top-k 20
      --jinja
    ttl: 0
turnstile_routing:
models:
  bonsai-2-27b: { slots: 2, ctxPool: 98304 }
virtual:
  bonsai-agent:
    backend: bonsai-2-27b
    maxCtx: 81920
    inject: { id_slot: 0 }
  bonsai-mem:
    backend: bonsai-2-27b
    maxCtx: 32768         # mem0 3.x extraction prompts estimate at ~11k tokens alone
    defaultMaxTokens: 1024
    inject:
      id_slot: 1
      chat_template_kwargs: { enable_thinking: false }
      temperature: 0.2      # mem0 sends no sampling params; JSON extraction wants low temp
      max_tokens: 2048      # nor a cap; this also sets its context budget
route: sandbox tap -> turnstile agent role (bench key) -> bonsai-agent; sandbox network none
